description: This PHP source file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleMeetingButton class, which is a specialized widget for rendering a button to schedule meetings within a subpanel interface in the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for generating a form and displaying the button, tailored for the 'Meetings' module.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleMeetingButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate, used for rendering a button to schedule meetings from a subpanel in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form string for creating a new meeting, prepopulated with relevant context and additional fields.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML output for the button if the user has edit access; otherwise, returns an empty string.
